The files a run writes, and their columns

Source: R/outputs.R
malariafwd-outputs.Rd

A run's directory holds:

  • events.tsv, one row per event, read by load_events();

  • state.tsv, one row per host and per mosquito per day, read by load_state();

  • params.tsv, the parameter set and the run's record, read by load_params() and load_run();

  • plasmo.trees, the tree sequence, found by trees_path() and read by ibd_pairs(), ibd_segments(), arg_summary() and simulate_genotypes();

  • model.slim, cmdline.txt, run.log and DONE: the model run, the command, its log, and the record that the run finished, with the size of every file.

Details

params.tsv has a param and a value column: the record rows ACTUAL_SEED, SLIM_VERSION and MALARIAFWD_VERSION, then every parameter with SEED, with the derived GENOME_LENGTH, N_CHROMOSOMES and RECOMB_WITHIN, and last EXTINCT_TICK or NEVER_STARTED when the run went extinct or never started. Whole numbers are written as such, other numbers to 15 significant digits with .0 on a whole one, flags as T or F, and text as given.

plasmo.trees holds one node per genome, keyed by its pedigree id, with node times in ticks before the end of the run; SLiM's second, vacant node of each genome is not a genome. A run with RETAIN_FULL_HISTORY = FALSE keeps the genomes alive at its end, and most earlier ones leave it.

See also

load_run(), load_events(), load_state(), load_params(), trees_path(), event_types()

events.tsv

One row per event, in the order the events were logged. -1 means not applicable and NA no lineage. A run with no event gives no row, and a column a file lacks reads as NA.

tick (integer)

the simulation day

event_id (character)

"<tick>_<counter>", unique

event_type (character)

the kind of event; event_types() lists them

inoculation_id (integer)

the bite or import that brought the parasite, on bite rows (vh_inoculation and its no-take form) and import rows (an import's batch row, logged the next day, carries its primary's id); -1 elsewhere

mosq_id (integer)

the mosquito, on uptake, bite and mosq_death rows; -1 elsewhere

human_id (integer)

the host; -1 only on mosq_death rows

lineage_id (integer)

the parasite's lineage, its clonal group; NA on recombinant uptakes, on course rows about the host (bloodcure_given, radcure_given, radcure_failure and their MDA forms) and on vh_inoculation_import_no_take

parent1_lineage_id (integer)

on uptake rows, the lineage of the first gamete; NA elsewhere

parent2_lineage_id (integer)

on recombinant uptake rows, the lineage of the second gamete; NA elsewhere

is_recombinant (integer)

1 on an outcrossed uptake (hv_uptake_recombinant), 0 elsewhere

p_outcross (double)

on uptake rows, the Simpson diversity of the gametocyte pool the mosquito drew from, to 6 significant digits, a diagnostic; 0 elsewhere

recipient (character)

"mosquito" on uptake and mosq_death rows, "human" on the others

is_dormant (integer)

1 on a hypnozoite batch's rows (its establishment, deaths and drug clearance), 0 on blood-stage and host rows, -1 on no-take rows

is_imported (integer)

1 when the parasite was acquired by importation, carried within the host to its batches, relapses and recrudescences; a local infection by an import's offspring is 0

pedigree_id (integer)

the genome, the key to the tree sequence (pedigree 0 is a real genome); -1 on uptake, course and no-take rows

parent1_pedigree_id (integer)

the genome a row's genome came from: a gamete of an uptake, the mosquito product of a bite, the batch of a relapse, the suppressed clone of a recrudescence; -1 where none

parent2_pedigree_id (integer)

the second gamete of a recombinant uptake; -1 elsewhere

n_hypnozoites (integer)

the hypnozoites a row stands for: a batch's size when established, the number activating, dying or cleared, or the reservoir surviving a radical-cure failure; 1 on other rows

oocyst_id (integer)

on an uptake row, the oocyst the mosquito made; on a local bite's blood-stage and batch rows, every relapse of that batch and the drug clearances of its clones, the oocyst of the infecting product; -1 for founders, imports and their batches and relapses, recrudescences, and rows that do not record it (human_clearance, hypnozoite_clearance, mosq_death, course rows)

detected (integer)

on the blood-stage onset rows of bites, imports, relapses and recrudescences, 1 if the observation layer reported the case and 0 if not; -1 elsewhere, founder seeding included

into_patent_lineage (integer)

on hypnozoite_activation rows, 1 if a patent clone of the same lineage, born on an earlier day, was still in the host (one that ends that day counts), 0 if not; -1 elsewhere

state.tsv

One row per host and per mosquito per day. load_state() gives the host rows, and entity = "mosquito" or "all" the mosquitoes' or both.

tick (integer)

the simulation day

entity_type (character)

"human" or "mosquito"

entity_id (integer)

the host's or the mosquito's id

tag (integer)

hosts: 1 if the host carries a patent blood-stage clone, or a subpatent one when SUBPATENT_INFECTIVITY > 0, whether or not it carries gametocytes; 0 otherwise, hypnozoites alone included; mosquitoes: 1 if it carries a parasite product, inside or past the EIP

moi_active (integer)

hosts: the distinct patent blood-stage lineages (the COI), suppressed clones excluded; mosquitoes: the distinct lineages it carries, inside the EIP included

moi_subpatent (integer)

hosts: the distinct lineages suppressed below patency, present but undetectable; 0 unless P_RECRUD_GIVEN_FAIL > 0

moi_dormant (integer)

hosts: the distinct genotypes in the hypnozoite reservoir

hyp_reservoir_size (integer)

hosts: the hypnozoites, the sum of the batches' counts

lineage_ids (character)

the lineages present, |-separated and de-duplicated, even for one; NA when none

n_transmissible (integer)

mosquitoes: the distinct lineages past the EIP; NA for hosts

mosq_age_days (integer)

mosquitoes: the age in days; NA for hosts

infectious_bites (integer)

hosts: the bites received that day from a mosquito carrying a product past the EIP, whatever the bite then did, the EIR's numerator; NA for mosquitoes
